aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden=\"true\">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
